change.compression: Both LAS and LAZ; temp suffix follows the actual header compression bit, not a filename.
change.records: Source-native bytes, classification/return bit fields, scales, offsets and XYZ remain unchanged.
change.missing_fields: Missing RGB/GPS dimensions and record fields stay absent; GPS time type is null without GPS.
change.crs: Only source WKT or GeoTIFF VLRs; missing CRS and vertical reference stay null/unknown.
